Moth-Eidol @VERSION@ (Windows x64)

HOW TO RUN
  1. Unzip this folder anywhere you can write (for example your Documents).
  2. Double-click MothEidol.exe. Nothing is installed and no administrator rights are needed.
  3. The app lives in the system tray; closing the window keeps it monitoring. Use the tray menu to quit.

IF WINDOWS SHOWS "Windows protected your PC"
  The app is not code-signed yet. Click "More info" and then "Run anyway".
  If the file was downloaded, you can also right-click the zip > Properties > Unblock before unzipping.

YOUR DATA
  Settings, projects and events are stored in %LOCALAPPDATA%\MothEidol. Delete that folder to start from scratch.
  The app only reads your log files, with the permissions of the Windows user running it.
